setup.title: Impact of Large Language Models on Academic Integrity in Universities
setup.problem_statement: This study investigates how LLMs affect academic integrity policies in higher education institutions, examining the gap between existing policies and emerging AI capabilities, and proposing a framework for responsible AI use in academic settings.
